title: At 91, Maeve McVeigh sinks 127-Yard hole-in-one, her second Ace since taking up golf at age 68
summary_full: Maeve McVeigh, a spirited 91-year-old golfer from Northern Ireland, achieved her second remarkable hole-in-one at Dungannon Golf Club. This stunning feat, accomplished during a ladies' winter league match, saw her send the ball 127 yards directly into the hole. Unaware of her accomplishment until a friend prompted her to check, McVeigh exemplifies how women are increasingly embracing golf and forming connections in their community.
